chapter: Early New Orleans drummers and bands
title: Never played parades; remembering boyhood parade bands
summary: He was a jazz musician who never marched; as a kid he heard Sam Morgan, Celestin's Tuxedo band and others in parades.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: I was wondering, did you ever play any brass band? I never played any parades. Never played any parades? No parades.
I had a lot of opportunities too, but I never did like to walk. Yeah. I had a lot of opportunities to play parades. I always was a jazz musician.
Do you remember any of the parades when you were a boy and following what bands you heard?
I remember hearing Sam Morgan and the parade following those. Celestine, the original tuxedo band. They had marching band. The record band. The old re-record band when I was a kid I remember those.
